Message:
drm/i915: Use intel_attached_dp() instead of hand rolling it

Replace the hand rolled intel_attached_dp() with the real thing.

@@
identifier F !~ "^intel_attached_dp$";
expression C;
@@
F(...)
{
<...
- enc_to_intel_dp(intel_attached_encoder(C))
+ intel_attached_dp(C)
...>
}
